name: Mara Ellison
title: Principal Broker and Founder
photoAlt: Mara Ellison standing by a window in a gray blazer
bio: Mara opened the brokerage in 2009 after a decade restoring historic homes in Montecito, and she still reads a house the way a builder does: roofline first, then the drainage, then the light in the kitchen at four in the afternoon.

She represents most of the firm's estate listings and works with a small number of buyers each year, usually people relocating who need someone to tell them plainly which streets flood and which canyons hold the morning fog.
shortBio: Mara founded the firm in 2009 and handles most of our estate listings in Montecito, Summerland and Carpinteria.

name: Julian Okafor
title: Associate Broker
photoAlt: Julian Okafor in a dark suit and glasses
bio: Julian spent six years as a land-use attorney before moving into real estate, which is why sellers on the Riviera and in Hope Ranch call him when a property has a complicated easement, an unpermitted guest house, or a neighbor with opinions.
He grew up on the Mesa and can tell you which blocks of Cliff Drive get the sunset and which get the wind.
shortBio: A former land-use attorney who handles the Riviera, Hope Ranch and the Mesa, and the paperwork nobody else wants to read.

name: Elena Varga
title: Director of Leasing
photoAlt: Elena Varga smiling, in a white shirt
bio: Elena runs the firm's leasing book: furnished seasonal homes, downtown residences and the long-term rentals that owners hand over when they move abroad. She places around ninety tenants a year and personally walks every property before it is listed.
If you are new to Santa Barbara and renting first, she is the person to start with.
shortBio: Elena manages leasing across the firm, from downtown residences to furnished seasonal homes in the foothills.

name: Daniel Reyes
title: Agent, Ojai and Summerland
photoAlt: Daniel Reyes in a gray sweater against a blue backdrop
bio: Daniel lives in the East End of Ojai and sells the valley's older houses: craftsman bungalows, ranch homes on a few acres of citrus, and the occasional adobe that needs a buyer with patience.
Before real estate he ran a small restoration crew, so his walkthroughs tend to include a flashlight and an honest opinion about the foundation.
shortBio: Daniel sells Ojai's older homes and ranches, and brings a contractor's eye to every walkthrough.
